scope: Public Chess.com default green board, white bottom, Apple Silicon Retina, packaged app. Basic continuous tracking and lifecycle verification; not the complete native corpus.

privacy.temporaryOnlyBoardCrops: At most 40 public board-only JPEGs retained for visual QA in the approved temporary build. Production has no frame/event logging.

initialScan.outcome: 32 pieces exact, zero uncertain squares; requires full-state confirmation

resize.recovery: Reselect source, fresh crop, preview/apply full known FEN

sourceClosure.firstDiagnostic: Resize/crop recovery was reported during closure; capture and advice stopped safely.
sourceClosure.verifiedMessage: The selected window stopped sharing. Reopen the browser window if needed and select it again.

timingDefinitions.automatic: First changed-frame Reading-board event after preceding Ready through first Ready with the next exact FEN. Includes interaction overlays and applicable engine search; excludes move time before detection and GUI paint.
timingDefinitions.manual: Capture command through Ready/correction. Includes capture and two-sample stability; Ready includes engine search. Initial chess-state confirmation and GUI paint excluded.
timingDefinitions.savedModelMetadata: recognition model/effort in raw timing entries are saved settings only; boardReader local and call counters establish no API requests.
